review_scope: Leader diligence plus six new intervention–disease families; bounded public-source review.

inventory_basis.scope_caveat: The 2026 Nature Metabolism source was also in a separately saved round 2 red-team memo; rechecked here and not counted as new.

candidate_updates.name: BLU3797: MTM1-specific liver gate and compartmental biology
candidate_updates.functional_evidence: No new exact-BLU human functional result. Add disease-specific hepatobiliary risk context and refine target readouts.

newly_resolved.finding: TAM4MTM investigator communication documents a hepatic safety halt; do not transfer causation to BLU. MTM1-loss zebrafish support testing canalicular function in a deficient background.
EEA1-associated PI3P/Rab4 recycling and lysosomal PI-Rag pathways refine the assay; generic total-lipid normalization is insufficient. 2026 NatMetab is a recheck, not newly discovered evidence.

candidate_updates.proposed_decisive_proof: At matched measured exposures, test post-deficit mature muscle force plus MTM1-deficient canalicular transport, each with a genetic rescue control. The latter is a model-development deliverable, not verified ready assay.
candidate_updates.stop_or_narrow: Do not advance a systemic package that needs active muscle exposure overlapping irreducible transport impairment. A positive muscle result cannot erase a disease-specific liver contradiction.
candidate_updates.ranking_change: Retain leading conditional proof priority; strengthen pre-commitment to disease-specific safety/transport endpoints.

candidate_updates.name: 8015-P2: public R364W assay route, source-purpose correction and allele-aware biology
candidate_updates.functional_evidence: No new exact-P2 human functional response or free-exposure result located.

newly_resolved.finding: CMTA describes an already-used BrainXell/ANANDA R364W motor-neuron morphology/transport service; one patient line and healthy comparator. Does not supply a force assay or a demonstrated P2 response.
The Summer 2024 table is donor recruitment, not inventory. It does not close the round 3 exact-T105M material gap.
The KU Leuven 2026 project describes MFN2/GARS1 organoid extension and stimulated function as planned development.
L248H/M376V independent work decouples shape from fusion. Prior R364W human-harm extrapolations were withdrawn in an author correction; human Chimera response is not P2 evidence.

candidate_updates.proposed_decisive_proof: Use exact-P2/parent/P1 comparison as a measured-exposure neuronal gate, then qualify mature transmission/force with genetic rescue and direct-muscle controls. Treat variant identity and compartment-specific function as part of the decision unit.
candidate_updates.ranking_change: Retain leading conditional priority; practical first assay route improves, but qualified human useful function remains a development task.

new_candidates.name: CLP290 for chronic SCI spasticity with preserved motor function

alias_search_basis.scope: Cumulative schema3 register including622 coverage rows,30 round2 proposals,36 round3 screens and embedded review texts
alias_search_basis.caveat: Absence under named aliases is inventory novelty only, not invention/patent novelty.

new_candidates.exact_entity: CLP290 carbamate prodrug of CLP257; Tocris 6758; CAS 1181083-81-7. Do not substitute the active parent or OV350.
new_candidates.indication: Chronic SCI spasticity with residual motor capacity
new_candidates.functional_evidence: 2018 staggered-lesion motor benefit and independent 2025 chronic complete-SCI assisted-stepping/reflex effect. Different tasks and models; not replicated unassisted walking.
new_candidates.independent_biological_units: 2018: starts 10 mice per group, ends with 8 vehicle and 10 drug at week 9. 2025: starts with 7 female rats; many endpoint analyses include 6. Paired limbs and EMG channels are nested within animals.

readiness.sourcing: public research catalog; stock/lot not verified
readiness.model: public chronicSCI assay descriptions; no execution here
readiness.exposure: 2025: single 100 mg/kg i.p. exposure; no human therapeutic exposure bridge established.
readiness.rights: issued neonatal-combination method patent exists; SCI claim mapping incomplete
readiness.differentiation: must outperform meaningful motor tradeoff of antispastic comparator; mechanism disputed

new_candidates.proposed_decisive_proof: Independent blinded vehicle/active-comparator experiment with post-deficit useful motor task, matched free exposure, force preservation and KCC2 versus GABA-A mechanism separation.
new_candidates.kill_or_narrow: Stop promotion if benefit only reflects nonspecific sedation, no force preservation, or infeasible exposure; retain target separately if exact compound mechanism fails.
key_limitations: The 2025 within-animal design lacks a described separate vehicle session.
Treadmill uses manual support and perineal stimulation.
CLP257 primary mechanism challenge includes GABA-A potentiation; genetic KCC2 efficacy does not prove drug specificity.
Washout behavior differs by study/endpoint; do not claim universal persistent restoration.

new_candidates.name: TAT-fused P110 for HSP axonal dysfunction

alias_search_basis.scope: Cumulative schema3 register including622 coverage rows,30 round2 proposals,36 round3 screens and embedded review texts
alias_search_basis.caveat: Absence under named aliases is inventory novelty only, not invention/patent novelty.

new_candidates.exact_entity: Cell-penetrating P110 construct corresponding to Tocris6897/CAS2770267-63-3, not bare heptapeptide CAS1411976-18-5.
new_candidates.functional_evidence: Patient-neuron mitochondrial, degeneration and apoptosis readouts improve; genetic controls strengthen disease/mechanism association. No restored neural circuit function established.
new_candidates.independent_biological_units: 2025 SPG15: 2 affected siblings plus an unaffected sibling, one family. 2022 includes SPG11/SPG48 patient backgrounds plus engineered and genetic controls; the aggregate donor denominator was not fully reconstructed. Mitochondria and fields are not donors.

readiness.identity: Complete cell-penetrating construct mapped to primary 2025 paper and catalog.
readiness.sourcing: two distinct P110 named products identified; stock/lot unverified
readiness.model: Published human cortical-neuron models; no transferred, qualified functional assay.
readiness.exposure: Nominal 1 micromolar cell exposure; human CNS exposure and therapeutic window not established.
readiness.rights: not exhaustively searched; public synthesis/catalog does not imply FTO

new_candidates.proposed_decisive_proof: Post-deficit axonal conduction or mature neuronal-network function across independent family backgrounds with exact-peptide authentication, intracellular exposure and genetic correction/DRP1 controls.
new_candidates.kill_or_narrow: Do not advance on morphology/ATP alone or if healthy neuronal quality control is impaired at active exposure.
new_candidates.non_independence: The 2022 and 2025 HSP papers share investigators; adding a subtype is not independent laboratory replication.

new_candidates.name: CDRI-1709S for established muscle atrophy

alias_search_basis.scope: Cumulative schema3 register including622 coverage rows,30 round2 proposals,36 round3 screens and embedded review texts
alias_search_basis.caveat: Absence under named aliases is inventory novelty only, not invention/patent novelty.

new_candidates.exact_entity: Named 3-hydroxy pterocarpan salt from the 2026 AdipoR1 study; exact full salt and stereochemical mapping not reconstructed.
new_candidates.indication: Established atrophy, initially distinguish glucocorticoid and denervation settings
new_candidates.functional_evidence: Rat grip/wire-hang and toe-spread results support further screening; established-deficit reversal is unproven in these treatment schedules.
new_candidates.independent_biological_units: Dexamethasone study: 6 rats per group. Denervation: 6 per group initially; day 7 control 5 and drug 6. Some controls were shared with separately reported medicarpin work.

readiness.identity: Named source and public synthesis reference; full identity mapping not independently reproduced.
readiness.model: Standard rodent and cell models; mature human muscle proof absent.
readiness.exposure: The paper compares nominal 100 nM in cells with an earlier approximately 120 nM total-plasma maximum; no free-muscle exposure bridge.
readiness.rights: Paper describes prior patented osteogenic work; exact claim mapping not performed.

new_candidates.proposed_decisive_proof: Qualify delayed established-atrophy force rescue versus active comparator, with measured free exposure and clean exact-article release.
new_candidates.kill_or_narrow: Hold if only co-treatment, prevention or passive paw-print changes persist; exclude reinnervation claims without nerve conduction.
key_limitations: Denervation treatment starts 24 hours after excision and ligation; toe-print spread is not restored nerve conduction.
Large synthesis supplement referenced but not fully inspected; this is not evidence that a route is absent.

new_candidates.name: BCH-HSP-C01 for AP-4-associated HSP

alias_search_basis.scope: Cumulative schema3 register including622 coverage rows,30 round2 proposals,36 round3 screens and embedded review texts

new_candidates.exact_entity: BCH-HSP-C01, publicly defined and resynthesized small molecule; Sigma SML4139.
new_candidates.functional_evidence: ATG9A/DAGLB trafficking response at micromolar concentrations; mature neuronal signaling/function or in-vivo efficacy not established.
new_candidates.independent_biological_units: One AP4M1 and one AP4B1 patient background, each compared with a sex-matched heterozygous parent. Wells and repeated differentiations are not independent donors.

readiness.identity: Public chemical identity and primary resynthesis.
readiness.model: Public patient-neuron trafficking assay; not qualified circuit function.
readiness.exposure: Approximately 5 micromolar cellular EC50; CNS physicochemical plausibility is not measured brain exposure.
readiness.rights: No ownership or FTO conclusion from bounded search.

new_candidates.proposed_decisive_proof: Test delayed rescue of a qualified mature neuronal functional deficit with measured intracellular exposure, then CNS exposure feasibility.
new_candidates.kill_or_narrow: Do not promote solely for cargo redistribution or presumed blood–brain barrier penetration.

new_candidates.name: Copanlisib for GNE myopathy

alias_search_basis.scope: Cumulative schema3 register including622 coverage rows,30 round2 proposals,36 round3 screens and embedded review texts
alias_search_basis.caveat: Absence under named aliases is inventory novelty only, not invention/patent novelty.

new_candidates.exact_entity: Copanlisib, pan-class-I PI3K inhibitor; exact research-material salt and purity must be specified.
new_candidates.functional_evidence: Organoid result is autophagic-flux/LC3 readout recovery, not contractile rescue. The immediate FDA-approved, marketed-drug premise is contradicted by the regulator.
new_candidates.independent_biological_units: Isogenic I329T neuromuscular-organoid comparison and other edited/myoblast systems; organoids and fields do not provide multiple patient donors.

readiness.sourcing: Research material may be sourced; withdrawn US marketing approval cannot be described as current approved availability.
readiness.model: Human isogenic neuromuscular organoid described; force not demonstrated.
readiness.exposure: Nominal 1 micromolar in selected assays; chronic muscle function and safety bridge absent.
readiness.regulatory: FDA withdrawal on 18 March 2024 for the follicular lymphoma indication.
readiness.differentiation: Autophagy restoration alone does not establish benefit or advantage relative to selective pathway tools.

new_candidates.proposed_decisive_proof: Only revisit with tolerable post-deficit functional rescue and an exposure rationale; evaluate a more selective strategy separately if warranted.
new_candidates.kill_or_narrow: No current priority for an approved-drug shortcut; neither approval withdrawal nor the autophagy result establishes GNE-myopathy efficacy.

new_candidates.name: Tamoxifen for XLMTM

alias_search_basis.scope: Cumulative schema3 register including622 coverage rows,30 round2 proposals,36 round3 screens and embedded review texts
alias_search_basis.caveat: Absence under named aliases is inventory novelty only, not invention/patent novelty.

new_candidates.exact_entity: Tamoxifen/ApoTamox clinical repurposing; not a substitute for PIK3C2B selectivity.
new_candidates.functional_evidence: Mouse late-start survival benefit exists; the human trial was halted for liver abnormalities, outweighing the straightforward repurposing rationale.
new_candidates.independent_biological_units: Late P30 low-dose mouse study: 8 treated and 4 controls. The clinical safety letter does not give the complete analyzed cohort. The webinar account describes 2 affected participants, not an efficacy denominator.

readiness.sourcing: Generic drug identity does not resolve indication-specific risk.
readiness.model: Mouse disease model published; no new experiment here.
readiness.clinical: TAM4MTM safety halt in 2024; full clinical efficacy dataset not recovered.
readiness.rights: Not the deciding barrier for the current rejection.

new_candidates.proposed_decisive_proof: No independent repeat mouse-efficacy package is justified until clinical disease-specific hepatic risk has a credible mechanistic resolution.
new_candidates.kill_or_narrow: Do not reclassify using generic availability or registry Completed status; do not transfer the same toxicity causation to BLU.
